# Lidonick

> Lidonick helps car dealership staff in any role (salespeople, sales managers, general managers, service directors, F&I, and BDC) set up their own AI agents and agentic workflows in AI tools they already have, for a one-time fee. Lidonick is dealer expertise plus prompt expertise ("You're only as good as your prompt"). It does not sell AI products or software, has no subscriptions or long-term contracts, does not replace a dealership's DMS or CRM, and is not affiliated with xAI or any AI company.

Contact: book a call at https://www.lidonick.com/#book.

## Main pages

- [Lidonick - Your store's AI, set up the right way](https://www.lidonick.com/): Dealers are paying for software they could build themselves. Lidonick helps dealership staff set up their own AI agents and workflows for a one-time fee.
- [Dealers Are Paying for Software They Could Build Themselves | Lidonick](https://www.lidonick.com/the-problem-with-dealership-software): Dealerships keep adding subscriptions and long contracts for tools that only do part of the job.
- [AI Consulting for Car Dealerships, No Subscription | Lidonick](https://www.lidonick.com/ai-consulting-for-car-dealerships): A one-time fee to help staff set up their own AI agents and workflows. No SaaS, no long-term contract.
- [How Dealership AI Setup Works | Lidonick](https://www.lidonick.com/how-dealership-ai-setup-works): Book a call, map the work, build the agents with the store, then hand it over.
- [AI for Every Role in the Dealership | Lidonick](https://www.lidonick.com/ai-for-dealership-staff): AI agents for GMs, sales, service, F&I, and BDC, set up in the tools the store already uses.

## Guides

- [Grok Bot for Car Dealerships | Lidonick](https://www.lidonick.com/grok-bot-for-car-dealerships): A role-by-role look at Grok Bot in a car dealership, from the GM to sales, service, F&I, and the BDC.
- [Grok Bot Prompts for Sales, Service, and F&I | Lidonick](https://www.lidonick.com/grok-bot-prompts-for-car-dealerships): Ready-to-use prompts for sales, service, F&I, GMs, and BDC teams.
